name: Wochenbrunneralm
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the Wochenbrunneralm in Ellmau**

Nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps** in **Tirol**, the **Wochenbrunneralm** is a true alpine paradise. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this idyllic mountain hut offers breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks and lush green meadows.

### **A Taste of Tradition**
Indulge in hearty alpine dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Käsekrainer**, and fresh **Tiroler Gröstl**, all prepared with locally sourced ingredients. Pair your meal with a glass of crisp **Tiroler Apfelstrudel** or a frothy **Schnaps** for the perfect alpine experience.

### **Adventure Awaits**
Whether you're hiking, mountain biking, or simply relaxing with a book, the **Wochenbrunneralm** is the perfect retreat. In winter, enjoy cozy evenings by the fireplace with warm **Glühwein** or a steaming bowl of **Käsesuppe**.

### **Location & Accessibility**
The **Wochenbrunneralm** is easily accessible by car from **Ellmau** (about 15 minutes) or via the **Zillertalbahn** (Zillertal Valley Railway). Parking is available nearby, and the hut is just a short walk from the trailhead.

### **Open Year-Round**
Experience the magic of the Alps in every season—whether it’s summer hiking, autumn foliage, winter skiing, or spring blooms. The **Wochenbrunneralm** welcomes you all year!

**Come and discover why this alpine gem is a must-visit in Tirol!**
